description: The signed-in couple's own booked vendors: the vendors that the couple marked as booked on Zola: the name, type, booking date, event date, price, whether the couple reviewed the vendor, and the vendor page. For the messages with vendors, use zola_list_my_vendor_messages. To find new vendors, use zola_search_vendors. Requires Zola sign-in (account:read).
name: zola_list_my_booked_vendors

outputSchema.description: The vendors that the signed-in couple marked as booked on Zola

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

account_vendor_id.description: The id of the booking on Zola

price_cents.description: The price that the couple entered

reviewed.description: The couple wrote a review of the vendor

url.description: The page of the vendor on zola.com

vendor_id.description: The id of the vendor in zola_search_vendors and zola_mark_my_vendor_booked. Null for a vendor that is not in the Zola catalog

title: List My Booked Vendors
